senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="Q00074">same</cite> [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 25:5">Targ. Job XXV, 5</cite> <he>פָּגְמָא סיהרא</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00077"><he>פְּגָמָא</he></cite>.]—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:6">Y. Ber. IX, beg. 12ᵈ</cite> <he>למרגלית דלית … פַּגְמָהּ</he> it is like a jewel of inestimable value, however high a price one may set upon it, one undervalues it.

<cite ref="Ketubot 41a:2">Keth. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא קא פָגֵים לה</he> when he does not damage her (in the public esteem); a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q00058"><he>פָּגִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00059"><he>פְּגִימָא</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="Q00058"><he>פְּגִימְתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 106a">Pes. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>כסא פ׳</he> a defective cup of wine (not full); <he>חביתא פ׳</he> a defective cask; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 116a:8">B. Mets. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דמִיפַּגְּמָא</he> because it is easily damaged (battered); a. e.
